steps.name: story of an old friend
steps.objective: Visit [Notos] at the “Nereis Gate” and report the quest.

lines.text: (Pneuma, which was quieter than any other place, has a noisy atmosphere. A lot of spirits are gathered in the place where Arche was.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aerura, what's going on? Why are the spirits gathered like this? Did Kairos tumble? And left?
(A lot of question marks appear above Aerura’s head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t know anything other than that? Then let's go and check it out. There are many spirits in Pneuma. How much is this? .
(After squeezing through many spirits, two people are seen. The purple eyes of the two people looking at the face of %s are unusually deeper today.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, did you rest well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a good rest, but Iris is here... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I couldn't access Pneuma on my own, but I was able to come when Elysia connected with Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Still, we can't get to Elysia yet.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The only person who can go to Elysia right now is %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I'm being asked to face another ordeal... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Being recognized as a person who can enter the place of God means being recognized.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wish I could work a little harder... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, don't say that. I'm sorry. If only I were a little stronger... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The bad things that happen in this world aren't your fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Arche, thank you for understanding. But we… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Where have you seen this before? Why does it look so familiar? It seems like we met for the first time today... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wanted to keep it a secret, but in some ways, I am a distant relative of Iris... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, I did. But that's not even a secret.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I wanted to be a person with lots of secrets, but it's a shame that they were discovered so quickly.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ahaha, Arche… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: See you often in the future. I will come visit you often.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Really?
(Iris holds Arche’s hands. Arche smiles brightly and looks at Iris.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. I was always alone except for the Pneumaen spirit, but then %s came, and Iris came too... . I love it!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Ah, %s… . right. I came because I have something to tell you. Regarding Hilda and Levi… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What kind of story do you want to hear?)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As Elisia connected with Pneuma, I learned a lot. Many choices were required, and in the process, I saw part of the future unfolding.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Complexly intertwined… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So I'm trying to unravel the skein that's been wrapped around me. First of all, I solved a few things.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Siam?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Siam was brought out of the darkness. There was some interference from witches and demons that interfered with my choice, but fortunately I resolved it well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: And I asked Siam to do something related to Hilda, so don't worry too much. I'll tell you everything else as soon as it's done.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris said this, so it must be okay….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy? Why Levy?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Levy is currently traveling to the continent of Freios in search of Pandora. I want to stop Pandora from doing anything that concerns her.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What Pandora is trying to do is... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't think it will stop, even as it gets closer to night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora told me not to get involved at night... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: At that time, I probably didn't know that Pandora would become so big.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As long as Pandora moves for Levy, Levy is not safe either. You may become a target for other witches approaching into the night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing that Iris mentions Levy….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… , what can I help you with? Tell me… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've only had a little break now, and I'm sorry for asking you to do something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Iris It's work.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please persuade Levy who is looking for Pandora. To return to Gndia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. So where is Levy now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know where Pandora is, but I know where Levy is going.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: After listening to the spirits... They say they are heading to Luria village, which can be seen along the Aisar River.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I will find Levy and persuade him.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: In the meantime, I will hold on to Hilda well. Don't worry too much. I won't endanger my Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll just go now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Goodbye. Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: See you later, Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you next time. Iris… .
(Iris slowly backs away with a greeting. Then, as if seeing off, the spirits chase Iris and head somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris probably can't be away for a long time either.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Sure.
(Arke, who was seeing Iris off, returns and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, are you sure you're okay now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. Thanks to Aerura, I feel better.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Actually, this is a secret... . Kairos and Kronos came to wake me up once in the middle of the night. The two of us woke up and went back exhausted. I thought I would wake up when it was time to wake up.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s Even though we had a really loud fight to wake him up, he didn't wake up. Anyway, I'm glad you're okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel sorry for no reason. Phew, Arche. I'll just go now too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please be careful. And don't push yourself too hard. Ask for help when you're having a hard time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know the way to Luria Village, so who should I ask? Let's ask Notos at the Nereis Gate.)

steps.name: Road to Laran Road
steps.objective: Visit [Ricotta] at “Nereis Gate” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Welcome, %s. A cool breeze blew from the open sea, so I wondered if a welcome guest was coming, but it turned out to be %s.
(Notus closes the magic book he was looking at and greets him with a friendly smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Notos. Has anything happened so far?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes, thanks to %s, I and the Nereis Gate are always having peaceful days. Oh, by any chance, where were you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luria village.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, if it’s Luria… . It is a village along the Aisar River. There is a historic site nearby, so it is a place often visited by archaeologists.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a gate leading there from Nereis Gate?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Unfortunately, there is no direct gate from Nereis Gate. Instead, I will tell you the directions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Notos.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There is a road that leads from Crystal Moon Forest to Laran Road, which can take you to Luria Village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, even though I went to Crystal Moon Forest last time, I didn't see the road to Laran Road... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It is said that a fire occurred in Crystal Moon Forest in the past, making it difficult to see the road to the outside.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: They say it's hard to find the way if you're not from the village, so it might be faster if you ask the forest keeper elf or someone who goes there often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the good information.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Come to think of it, I heard that Miss Ricotta, who helps with the gate work, is going to Laran Road today. Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ms. Ricotta has been there a few times and is knowledgeable about geography, so how about accompanying her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let me ask you one question. Notos, I'm going to go see Rico. See you later.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Since my break is over, I'm going to go fix the gate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, about Zephyrus… I think Zephyrus will do it himself, so I don’t have to do it first, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go to Ricotta….)

steps.name: Guide Ricotta
steps.objective:
1. Go to “Crystal Moon Forest” through the gate at “Nereis Gate”.
2. Arrive at “Laran Road” through the gate in “Crystal Moon Forest” and be sure to find [Leon] on “Laran Road” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you, Rico?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I completed several missions while staying at the gateway. Both visible and invisible... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Adventurer, how have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot of things happened.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: How much can you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . right. As for Rico… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Once again... . I want to help where I can. Have you met any other witches along the way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Ricotta briefly about meeting the witch Morgana at the Twilight Cathedral.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I didn't know. Did something like that happen in Crystal Moon Forest? .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If such a force shook Riftrasir and the Crystal Moon Forest, the Moonlight members must have felt it to some extent... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Considering that I didn't notice anything, the witch's power is truly amazing. The same goes for what happened on Aie Island.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: There are not just one but more such witches... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rico can't help you right now. I'll ask you later if it comes up.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you were going to Laran Road, right? I would like you to tell me the way to Luria Village. I need to meet someone... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm planning to go too, would you like to go with me? Or should I tell you separately?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then follow me.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: First, we will take the gate to Riftrasir and go to Crystal Moon Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Rico.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: If you really appreciate it, please give me one the next time you see a pretty doll... . Then I'll leave... .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Do you see a road over there? If you go straight from here, you will reach Laran Road.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is the road. I can see it so well, why didn’t I see it back then? uh… .
(Ricotta suddenly looks around.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: (It's a bit strange to blame it on my mood...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Rico feel something too?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes… , But I don’t think it’s that dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they were targeting us, they would have already done so.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: You must have done that, right? Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I will only guide you to places in the center of Laran Road. Today is the day Leon comes out to check out the facilities on the highway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Leon?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I'm from Luria village. As I was passing through Laran Road, I asked about this and that, and he kindly gave me some information.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then shall we go?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I will take the lead. %s.

steps.name: Wolf beastman of Laran Road
steps.objective: Defeat [Bronze Madillo] and [Hiade of India] in “Laran Road” and return to [Leon] in “Laran Road” to report the quest.

lines.text: (You can see a large dam that seems to have blocked the river flowing between the green mountains and hills. The slightly bouncing water droplets approach the walking group, giving them a sense of coolness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, here… . awesome… .

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: I was like that at first too. I was passing by this place on a mission, and I was impressed by the scenery.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Building such a magnificent structure without harming nature... .
Uh, ricotta? Do you see me often these days?
(When someone calls Ricotta in a friendly way, %s's gaze naturally shifts.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
Riririko, who is this person?
(The person who was calling Ricotta arbitrarily walks forward from behind.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Ah, Leon… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Leon… . uh?
(When a large person appears, I raise my head and look forward to see someone who is not an ordinary person standing there.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'm Leon. You, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adventurer is correct... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Did you come with Rico Rico?
(The wolf beast grins and offers to shake hands.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Leon. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: %s, %s… . I've heard that name before, but where did I hear it?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: But %s, aren’t you surprised when you see the prisoner? Shouldn't we be a little surprised to see such a handsome and cute werewolf?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've seen people similar to Leon on other continents. I also saw another prisoner near El Anor.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: People? Adventurer, did you just call me human?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Wow! You are different from other people. Thanks, I love it! Adventurer, it's the best!
(Leon smiles broadly and grabs %s's arms and shakes them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I felt it from the moment we shook hands. He was very strong.)

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Leon, %s, don't squeeze your hand too hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I was so happy that he treated me like a normal person. That's why I like Korikori too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Phew, Leon… . If you're going to call them, please unify them as one. If it’s ricotta, it’s ricotta, if it’s ricotta, it’s ricotta.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yes, ricotta. What's going on today?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Please guide %s to Luria Village. I have to go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leon, if you are busy, just tell me where to go.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: No. I took a look around and found that there were no major problems, so I decided to go back. It worked. Because I saw Cocory too.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: It's ricotta.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Leon, we’re parting here today, but if you don’t call me properly the next time we meet… .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: What if I don’t?

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: We will tie them up tightly and throw them in a room in Hell, Purgatory, or the Cathedral of Dusk.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I don't know where it is, but it seems somehow dangerous.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Then take care of %s, Leon.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Okay, Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Rico. See you later.

lines.speaker: 리코타
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.
(As soon as Rico says hello, he walks quickly towards the crossroads in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: That's right. I forgot I had a favor to ask Rico.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Recently, the wild animals that we often see on the Laran Road have become fierce. Moreover, monsters of unknown origin also appeared... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Ricotta saved me when I was besieged by them and begging for help. So this time too… .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Ah… … .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Adventurer, you didn't hear this just now. You must never, ever go to the village and talk to the villagers.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: You will definitely be treated like a puppy. I'm a wolf, but they keep making me lose my identity.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. So all you have to do is calm the animals down and clean up anything that looks like a monster, right?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I feel like I was tricked, but I have to help first.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hehehe. Adventurer! Cheer up, Adventurer!

steps.name: Create a comfortable path
steps.objective: Defeat [Drooling Hepring] and [Parupa] in “Laran Road” and be sure to report the quest to [Leon] in “Lulia Village.”

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, great. Adventurer! It's absolutely the best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it done now?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Like ricotta, Adventurer, what do young people eat these days to make it so great?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How old is Leon? It’s hard to tell because he’s a werewolf.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Adventurer, why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to know Leon's age... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Me? Twenty years old.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry. sorry. I talked to Grandma Helena a lot, and I think her speaking style changed. Sorry, sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . It can happen.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Did you think I was someone who threw courtesy into thin air?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, no. Not at all.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Just kidding, kidding. Adventurer. I like it! Okay, Adventurer! Then let's go to the village.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry, but I have to repeat what I just did on the way. Uncle Mathias said that Jun's way to town should be comfortable... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Uncle Mathias and who is Jun?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'll explain as I go. Let's go first! Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm so clueless...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Leon! Let's go together! I don't know the way here!

steps.name: Anxiety met again
steps.objective:
1. After talking with [Leon] in 「Lulia Village」, go to 「Lalan Road Vacant Lot」.
2. After the story ends at “Laran Road Clearing,” return to “Lulia Village” and report the quest to [Mathias].

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Whoa, arrived! Awww!
(As soon as you enter the village, you can see windmills and watermills spinning with the wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful here too. So much so that I want to go for a walk right now... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Right? Although there are people who have never come to our village of Luria, there is no one who comes only once. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: By the way, Adventurer. That's cool. Is it possible to deal with that many guys so easily?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leon is also great. Scar away many animals and defeat monsters.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Hey, don’t float it into the air. Compared to Adventurer, I'm just an ordinary person from the neighborhood. Oh, are you an ordinary neighborhood prisoner?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: By the way, Adventurer, what are you going to do in our town?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a friend.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Friends? Adventurer Your friend must be a great person, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. He's a great person.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Should I look for it too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Leon. Uh, Leon?
(Suddenly, Leon's movements slow down and then stop. %s's vision is distorted, as if someone was playing a prank.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .
(%s The footsteps of people passing by suddenly slow down and then stop. At that moment, an unfamiliar figure appears next to the people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne.
(The being whose name was called slowly approaches %s's side.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I tried to leave quietly, but you recognized me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Just like last time, I have nothing to do with you today either. Oh, do you remember this?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Looking at your expression, I remember... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense, just tell me what you are doing here... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Is that why you want to hear my story? Then I'll tell you somewhere out of town.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: tell me here

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: A suspicious person... . Should I hold an unexpected village hostage because of your demands?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There must be a place somewhere on the Laran Road that no one can reach. If you follow the strange power you feel, you will find me... .
(Daphne smiles, turns her back, and walks out among the people. When Daphne's appearance disappears like an illusion, the villagers' time, which had slowed down, returns to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go quickly.
(%s, who came to his senses and looked around, met Leon's worried gaze in front of him.)

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Adventurer, why are you talking to yourself? Is it because you're tired?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no. Oh, Leon, let me ask you one question. Are there places along the road that people shouldn't go to?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Oh, it exists. There is an empty lot with absolutely nothing in it. Originally, a Magic Agency warehouse was planned to be built there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Agency?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Yeah. ah… . It's up to Uncle Mathias to tell you this... . Do you need any explanation?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll hear the explanation later. Because I was in a hurry... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'd like to guide you, but I have work to do in town... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Just tell me where I'm going.

(Because of the crooked guide map of the Laran Road that Leon drew, I end up wandering along a path that I shouldn't have to wander through. Then, my steps naturally stop at a place that appears to be the end of the Laran Road.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's here. As Leon said, an empty space with nothing… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, come out now. Where are you?
(When you recognize a place where there is nothing other than the river and dam visible in the distance, the surrounding air changes slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, come out now. Keep your promise.
(A woman's voice, not Daphne, is heard behind %s, who is looking around.)
(A blonde woman in a black gothic dress decorated with red ribbons and roses slowly passes by %s.)
The rabbit witch didn't make any promises to you from the beginning. If you make a good promise, you can't go back on it... .
Is it inevitable that witches will meet witches?
Daphne, if you have anything to do with Pandora, don't play around and show yourself... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… ? Pandora?!
(As soon as the woman who identified herself as Pandora finished speaking, the curtains surrounding her disappeared one by one, and the figure of a woman with her long ears prickling was revealed.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hello, Pandora.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Is this your first time seeing something like this? I worried a lot because I didn’t know what type of meeting I liked. Do you like it, Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I didn't like pranking %s, but I commend you for doing it to meet me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, I know you have a lot to say to Daphne, but I'd like you to step aside for a moment. Because that rabbit witch used you because of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, you are kind to Pandora. Show me that too.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Stop talking about useless things... . Daphne, how close are you to the night?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There's still a long way to go before it's deep into the night, but with your help, it'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The night you want and the night I want are probably different, so I don't know why you're asking for help.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That's because you are Levy's master.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What did you say just now?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, if you help me, there will be no problem. No one gets hurt. Of course, Levy... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Ugh… .
(The moment Daphne mentions Levi, drops of blood burst out from the wound on Daphne's cheek.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Say it again.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe, I thought so too. Because he is a precious person to you.
(Daphne wipes the blood away as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It sounds like you don't mind if I kill you here... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, can you really kill me?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You probably know. If you kill me, you'll never meet Levy. And that you can't even reach the goal you want.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Where is Levy now?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now it's up to you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora… .
(The thick darkness that suddenly approaches creates a wall in front of Daphne. And the witch's smile seen behind the wall binds the steps of Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Are you ready to open the box?
(With those words, the darkness shatters like glass breaking. And the figure of Daphne, who was standing behind, also breaks into pieces and scatters.)
(As the darkness that stayed for a while disappears, you can feel the cold air of Laran Road.)
(Pandora is looking at the sky with a dejected expression.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I was ready from the moment I left the mansion. But, just hearing Levy's name doesn't do anything... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, are you okay?
(Pandora stares at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I felt it the first time I saw you, but you always take care of others.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That is what has allowed you to live until now and become a strong person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you praising me?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Because Levy said to praise people who have good qualities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something… It seems like a lot has changed.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Is that so? As I regained my strength little by little, it became like this. It may be difficult to return to my original self... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Still, it was enough to come to the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't mean that it has changed, but...)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, you'd better go back. Because it's still dangerous to approach Night of the Witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know the witch's fate.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: How much do you know? no way… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I met the person who gave me the fate of the night chaser. And the night chasers killing each other... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I knew I was running an errand for the Star God, but I never thought I would find out this far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know what you're going to say. Do you think I killed a witch?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I don't kill witches. I've never killed a witch.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You wouldn't believe that I, Agashra, didn't do something like that even after being given the fate of a witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll believe it.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And we're looking for Levy too. I came here to persuade Levy.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Please tell me in detail.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Levi is on the continent of Freios to find Pandora, he may become a target of other witches.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, I was asked by Iris to persuade Levi to return to Gendia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because Levi said he was going to Luria Village, but I didn't know I would meet Pandora.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I have something to give to Levy, it's somewhere on Laran Road. That's what I came here for. I know what you're worried about.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Anything I do for Levy will never be done using methods or methods that Levy dislikes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Let's find Levy together. The rabbit witch might be playing around again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let’s go to the village together.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's inconvenient to have a lot of people, so I want you to talk to the villagers. I'm not used to that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I understand. I will take the lead.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: After all, you are a person who knows even if you don’t know… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By the way, you have to go to town and talk to someone first.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Leon kept talking about a man named Uncle Mathias. He said he would tell me who he was...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's go to that person first. If you ask, you'll find out something.)

steps.name: his whereabouts
steps.objective: Continue the conversation with [Mathias], [Yeonhee], and [Helena] in “Lulia Village” in that order. Then report the quest to [Juen] in “Laran Road.”

lines.text: (A man with a bulky, muscular physique stares at the unfamiliar traveler who comes to visit him.)
This is my first time seeing you. Are you a traveler?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is my first time visiting Luria. You are Mr. Mathias, right?

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I am the chief of this village, no... You say you're representative Mathias, but what brought you here to see me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce myself. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: %s, %s… . I think I've heard this name before... .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Anyway, you seem to be looking for something, let me help you. Did you come alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, the group... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Look ahead.
(Pandora makes eye contact and nods to look ahead.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that I have company, I'm just looking for someone. Chief.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Chief, no... representative… . no. Hey, just call me Mr. Mathias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Mr. Mathias.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I like the village chief, but my daughter doesn't like the title 'village chief' because she thinks it sounds old-fashioned.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: So what are you looking for?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for a friend. It's Levi... .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Hmm… . It's not easy to find just by name. Let me know your impressions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is a young man with blond hair and blue eyes, and he is so beautiful that many women fall in love with him at first sight.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Haha… . That would be someone Jun shouldn't meet. Ah, Jun is my lovely daughter. Originally he was Juen, but everyone calls him Jun for convenience.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The person Leon was talking about is Mr. Mathias’ daughter.)

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: Ah! I remembered! Looks like that handsome guy was in town.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: A few days ago, the village ladies ran out screaming with joy. Where are you going? Could you please look here for a moment? He said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected... .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: I don't know where it is now. I looked around the village again today, and there were only the people I saw every day... .

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: It is difficult to determine which accommodation a guest is in. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 마티아스
lines.text: If Jun gives the kids snacks and lets them play detective, they can find it quickly. But, I'm on the road right now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, thank you just for your words. Then I'll wander around a little more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… , Then who should I ask?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to look around the village again.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Sorry, traveler sister. You fell because of me. My glasses also broke.
(Leon extends his hand towards Yeonhee, who fell after colliding with him.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's okay. Because I have more glasses.
(Yeonhee smiles brightly and tries to grab the person in front of her.)
(The startled Pandora quickly retreats, and Yeonhee, unable to grab anything, falls down on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeonhee, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Uh, it's %s's voice... .
(Yeonhee rubs her eyes and seems to be talking to %s, but her gaze is directed at Leon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's over here.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's a bit difficult to tell people apart because I don't wear glasses.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Does Adventurer look like me…? . Anyway, I'm sorry. glasses. I'll compensate you.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm really okay with it, but I can't help but compensate for it. The thing that just broke was something specially made by the Magic Agency of the Sylvaria Empire, so it cost about 3 billion Ellie... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Traveler sister, I don’t have that much money… . Sorry.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It was a joke. In fact, 300 million Eli... .

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Save me... . It's expensive too. Ugh.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: It's my fault for not looking ahead, so don't worry about it.
(Yeonhee takes out new glasses and puts them on.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Wow, I can finally see it clearly now. If I don't wear glasses, I can't see anything... . Hey, can you tell me your name?

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: It's Leon.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Leon, Leon… . That's a good name. Leon, thank you for your concern. My name is Yeonhee and I am from Elias, the continent of Gendia.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I think you know Adventurer, so you weren't surprised to see me.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Since you are a guest in the village, please call me anytime if you have any questions or need anything. I'll treat you right.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: I'm going to prepare a fish dish for dinner. Do you want to eat it?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Hehe, I won’t decline that.

lines.speaker: 레온
lines.text: Okay, then let me grab the right one! If you get hungry later, howl here. Okay? Bye then!
(Leon waves his hand and runs towards the river behind the village.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I'm really looking forward to seeing what the fish dishes here are like. But, what is howling? . Oh, the dogs say, “Awwwww.” Oh my, you’re so cute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Yeonhee. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I always get along well. I didn't even get lost this time. I went to the capital and came right away after hearing about Luria, and I think it was a good job as expected.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: By the way, %s, why did you come here? I don't think it's normal... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Yeonhee, you know Levi, right? My name is Levi Ahrens... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Of course I know. In Elias, if you don't know Levy, you're no better than a octopus. By the way, what's going on with you, Levy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not it... . I'm looking for him for personal reasons, but I heard he came to town a few days ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why I asked Yeonhee if she knew.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I arrived late yesterday, so I didn't see Levy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: When I see Levy, I will tell him that %s is looking for him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I meet Levy, I will also give you my regards.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I hope you find it quickly. That wouldn't be a bad thing, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, yes. no.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thank goodness. Oh, there's an old man over there. Did you ask him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: The old man was kind and helped me explore the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Yeonhee.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have a nice trip! See you later, Yeonhee.
(Yeonhee waves her hand and says goodbye to %s. Then, while wiping her glasses with a small cloth, she looks into the distance as if she found something.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: (That woman didn’t just run into me, right?)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I can finally see the scenery clearly. I need to write down a lot of what I observed. Hehehe.
(Yeonhee, putting her glasses back on, looks around and admires the sight of the village.)
(Pandora checks the back of Yeonhee as she goes to see the fishing spot and hurries after %s.)
(An elderly woman sees a stranger in the distance, looks ahead, and closes the book she was reading while enjoying her tea.)
Is that him... .
(%s's steps move briskly, not knowing that the elderly woman is recognizing her. Meanwhile, Pandora grabs the lapel of %s, who is ahead.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? why?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That person is not an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doesn't seem like a problem?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Okay. Then you ask. Even though I won't be visible to that person anyway... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(The elderly woman places the teacup on the table and looks intently at the approaching face of %s.)
Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. uh… ? Do you know me?
I thought I knew this person, but it seems I didn't.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what you're talking about. I have something to ask the villagers... .
I see. Then let me introduce myself. I am Helena Sylvaria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... . yes?!
(The elderly woman who introduced herself as Helena gives a small smile as if %s's reaction is amusing.)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Why are you so surprised? I am the aunt and grandmother of Her Majesty, Dana, and Shiina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, you were a member of the royal family. The atmosphere was somehow similar.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It's hard to say anything about this person because he's half-hearted. Because the child was not born to the empress... . Still, my brother cared for me a lot. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You seem to be talking about all sorts of things. I've heard a lot about %s. So I could recognize it right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You thought I was coming after hearing about Helena... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So what is the business? %s… . Personally, I hope it doesn't have anything to do with the Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not about the empire, I'm looking for someone personally.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It seems like something important. I don't know if this person will help... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is a young man traveling from Gendia, with blond hair and blue eyes... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Did you say Levi Ahrens? A young man with charm, who was beautiful and full of dignity, and who naturally led people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you know?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I remember him as a handsome young man that is rare these days. I haven't seen that much beauty in my life.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: How did I know that this person was a retired archaeologist? He asked me various things about the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were an archaeologist. Oh, that thing over there looks like a relic... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I recognize you. I love history and artifacts, so I've been doing this since I was young.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: We also discovered the ruins of Aegir near the village, and by studying the artifacts, we uncovered a few stories that Theodore would enjoy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are amazing. Come to think of it, the professor also knows.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Theo is a child I consider to be my nephew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... . Oh, have you seen Levy since?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I haven't seen that young man since that meeting.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If we returned to the village, the girls would have screamed happily. Juen also kept asking if he had seen that person during the meal... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helena, can I enter the ruins? There is something I want to check.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You don't need to get permission. If you go in, you'd better be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something in the ruins?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: After this person retired, other archaeologists were injured while investigating the ruins. Artifacts and mechanical devices that could not be answered no matter how much they investigated suddenly moved... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I tried to check, but His Majesty didn't know how and stopped me. You saw the foresight.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So we dispatched a team of knights to investigate and concluded that they move under special circumstances.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Still, I feel a little uneasy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So something like that happened….)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I've heard from my kids that you're a strong person, but there's no harm in being careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If that's the case... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: There is something like a large rock standing far outside the village. Can you see it? Those are the Aegir ruins.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: So %s, I hope you find what you're looking for. And if there is a child named Juen in front of the historical site, tell him to come in before sunset.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Helena, thank you for your words.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will also tell Juen.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Thank you. Ah, it's already time... . This guy needs to go get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it’s because of me… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: No. It's natural at this age. Hehehe. See you later, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, take a break. Helena.
(As Helena walks away, Pandora quietly taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You were right. A person named Helena, she's not average, but it's not a problem.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Let’s go… . I need to see inside the ruins. Little by little, I feel like Levy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can you feel each other’s magic?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, shall we go now?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yeah.

steps.name: lost angel
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Juen] in 「Laran Road」. 
2. Defeat [Rafaella] at “Aegir Ruins” and report the quest to [Juen].

lines.text: You ungrateful bastard!!
(A short-haired girl dressed as an explorer grabs a creature that appears to be a freeling species and shakes it.)
You don't even eat food and you don't even eat what you give it?! Freelings in other neighborhoods say this is delicious.
(The winged freeling spits out what appears to be food from its mouth.)
My dad told me that I wasn't giving him food. Hello, Heffling. you. There will be no food starting tomorrow.
(The creature called Heffling by the girl looks panicked as if it understood what the girl said.)
(However, he soon lies down with his stomach showing with a relaxed expression.)
Ah, you! Do you think you'll get angry if I do this? Heffling, this is really too much.
Your ears are cute!! Hey, do you think I’ll keep bringing you food if it’s like this?
(The girl pats the Hepring's stomach, takes out a snack from her bosom and shakes it. The Hepring then shakes its front paw with sparkling eyes.)
I'm giving it to you today, but only this once. Phew. I heard that the real archaeologist sisters taught them wrong habits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Junen by any chance? Jun?
Yes, my name is Juen. Jun too, huh?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Huh? Wow!! Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Juen?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Just by looking at it, I was surprised to see that it had a cool Adventurer appearance! It's absolutely the best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was my first time hearing such a thing, so I was a little taken aback. I am %s… .

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: %s? %s? Wow!! Is it him by any chance? The apostle of justice who defeated all kinds of villains, the goddess' bastard?! uh? Are you a bastard of justice?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, being a bastard... I guess this is your new title.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . You were wrong. My name is Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I never thought I would meet such a wonderful person. I'm so moved. But what's going on with the ruins?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for something. I also told Helena about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Helena asked me to tell you to return before sunset.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Yes, that's right. But Adventurer! If you heard the story from your grandmother, it would be dangerous... . Would you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. I'm used to this kind of thing... .

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow, that's cool. I also want to explore like Adventurer... . It won't work, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not now, but maybe someday. But don't give up.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow, great words. thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…This child is too burdensome….)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Oh, that's right! Be careful because there are a lot of hungry hefflings inside.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I think the archaeologists who visited the Aegir ruins saw it for the first time and thought it was amazing and gave it a delicious snack.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: After that, he stopped looking for food and continued to eat snacks alongside the archaeologists.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: My dad weighs about as much as a heavy log, and these guys weigh about that much.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: To people who see them often, like me, they approach with some control of their strength, but to people who see them for the first time, they cannot control their strength, so they fly away.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Would you believe that Heffling and the explorers who crashed into them and flew into the open sea were not the only ones?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Come explore and tell me what happened when you get back!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. It's not difficult, so I'll do it. See you later then. Juen.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Adventurer, have a nice trip!
(Heffring, who was lying down and eating a snack, waves his front arm toward Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Freelings are lazy? It's fascinating... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can feel Levy’s energy within me. I have to go quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let’s go in quickly… .
(Inside the imposing ruins of Aegir, the wind blows with the smell of wet earth between the well-maintained paths.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's because it's a ruin, but there are definitely a lot of old traces.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's gone. Levy's energy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's keep going inside.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yeah… .
(The moment Pandora tries to walk forward, a large lance falls in front of the two.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Luckily, I got out of the way, so don’t be scared.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This is a weapon imbued with sacred power... . somehow… . Was this why Levy's energy disappeared?
(From inside the ruins, a woman with a cat-like appearance approaches, flapping her white wings.)
(A woman resembling the battle angel Michaela casually pulls out a large lance stuck on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Battle Angel… ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I've been alive for a long time, but this is my first time seeing a battle angel... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is one person in a hidden place.
(The battle angel looks at the two people and raises his lance.)
Rafi will speak, so listen carefully. It's dangerous here. It's no place for humans... . Now, wait… . What are you?!
(The battle angel wearing intense red armor looks embarrassed.)
Among the humans who have received God's protection, there is no one that Rafi does not know... . Human, what are you? And why are you a demon?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You don't know Agashura... ? And what is Rafi?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What is Agashura? Rafi doesn't know that. And Rafi is me. I'm Rafi.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No time, %s… . Let's leave the battle angel alone. We need to find Levy.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Levy? What is levi? Is this what you guys are looking for?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It would be incredibly important if humans and demons who received God's protection search for it together.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: If that's the case, Rafi might be able to get out of here... . We have to go out quickly and help Orca.
(As soon as the battle angel finishes speaking, it flaps its wings vigorously and flies at high speed into the depths of the ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There, there! Rafi!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that angel thinking? I don't understand. If you can't get out of here, it means you're trapped... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, stop thinking and let’s go. There is no need to think long here and now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Let's go quickly. We have to find Levy faster than that angel.
(Even though the two search through the Aegir ruins, Levi is not found. The only thing that greets them are strange artifacts and mechanical devices that awaken and move with some will.)
(As a bonus, there is even a Heffling that runs towards the person, or rather the food the person is holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was a reason why everyone told me to be careful. By the way, where is Levy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can feel Levy's spirit. It definitely seems like it's here... . Why can't I see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it true that you came here?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm not sure... . I thought I knew everything about Levy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, stop!
Boom!
(Just like when she first entered the Aegir Ruins, a large lance falls in front of Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi needs to get out of here. I need to go out and help Orca.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So, even if you have nothing to do with Rafi, if you try to interfere with him, I will take him down... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafi, that’s not it… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: The only person who can call Rafi as Rafi is Rafi!
(As the battle angel flaps its wings, the enormous energy within the ruins gathers and approaches as a strong wind.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Anything that gets in your way will fly away!!
(Pandora, who was about to open the magical barrier with a single word from the battle angel, is blown away by a strong wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora!!
(Pandora cannot be seen because it flew so far away.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It was annoying so I threw it away. It's just you and Rafi here now. Rafi needs to find Levi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy is not a thing... .
(Once again, a sharp lance passes by %s.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Just because you have God's protection doesn't mean you can interfere with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. I have no choice but to somehow tie the angel's feet.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: If you're going to try it, give it a try. Because I won’t take it lightly!!
(The battle angel's lance bounces away from %s's counterattack.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What are you, you can't do this. How can you stand up to Rafi's attacks?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Angel, listen to me. If we fight like this, we can't do anything.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi says he doesn’t want to hear it! Wow, you're really annoying. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Oh, that's right! That's it.
(In an instant, the battle angel's wings grow enormously. With a single flap of the wings, the enormous energy within the ruins gathers again and approaches as a strong wind.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You too, get out of here!! And don't come in!
Boom.
(The wind generated by the battle angel blows %s's body somewhere and falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . What on earth…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's in the direction of the ruins exit. What on earth is sending it away while fighting? . Phew, I have to go back in.
(I try to move towards the direction I came from, but I can't go back because a barrier of unknown force has been created.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Neither you nor I can go back the way we came. Nothing can be done like this.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The first thing to do is to talk to angels and resolve misunderstandings... . Although it appeared arbitrarily, the angel's appearance was by no means accidental.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I wish I could get help from the angel you mentioned... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you go to Michaela, you might have an answer. But, Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Why… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be that Levy left?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Probably not. If Levy had felt my power, she would never have left Laran Road.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But, something is strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll tell you when I get back... . Just in case, I'll take a look at Laran Road in the meantime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: How to resolve misunderstandings
steps.objective: Visit [Aurum] in “Sanctuary Eidos” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then let’s see it again here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go to the sanctuary... . You disappeared... .
(As soon as Pandora finishes speaking, she disappears without a trace. Juen, who was sitting and reading a book, looks at Adventurer and makes an expression of confusion.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Are you out already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I went in hastily. I'm going to go in properly prepared.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: It was a bit noisy inside... , what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like a mechanical device is moving. It's dangerous, so don't go inside.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Really? Will the hefflings be okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay if you don't care about those guys. You were good at avoiding it, right?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: … You can avoid it on your own. That's surprising, Heffling. Adventurer. Then prepare well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juen, see you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to the sanctuary quickly.
(After Adventurer leaves, Heffling stops eating and looks in the direction of the ruins, as if he saw something.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Heffring, what's wrong? What's over there? There's nothing... .
Freeling, can you see me? Then listen to me carefully. You know what you have to do here for this child.
(Heffring makes eye contact with the boy and nods.)
Okay, Freeling. good job.
(Juen, perhaps not recognizing the boy, sits down with Hepring next to him and begins reading the book again.)
(A boy with his face and legs bandaged walks out to the river, leaving Juen and Hepring behind.)
There is a being in the world that I and the Battle Angel don't know about... . As expected, it seems like a lot of time has passed.
I thought it would be okay if I ran away to the demon world... , I can't believe I'm trapped in the garden.
Anyway, I need to know what happened... .
(The boy takes a deep breath and holds up a cup that looks like a chalice. Then, the previously empty cup fills with clean water.)
Star of twisted fate, show me the memories you hold.
(The boy drinks water with his eyes closed. Then he opens his eyes and pours the remaining water onto the floor.)
A world with almost no gods left... .
Either die or run away, or even if you stay, you don't stay... . Hahahaha, is this fun?
Phew, I guess I'll go back to the garden and see what the being created by Hecate's will does.

steps.name: Mika and Rafi
steps.objective: Visit [Juen] in “Aegir Ruins” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum, how are you?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What am I… .
(Aurum looks at the sky with lonely eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're on probation.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I returned to the capital after a long time and had to go to the commercial district, but a thief appeared and chased me with the intention of catching him... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I guess I overdid it a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much did you push yourself to be put on probation again?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Because the opponent was not ordinary. He was a boy who was a beastman flying around on a large magic golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Noname and Lyricaria?)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: We ended up making a mess while trying to catch the boy. Argent caught me and got angry, asking what I would do if I got hurt... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Still, it ended well, with people supporting me in front of the Magic Agency and the Council. Instead, I listened to nagging people for half a day telling me to leave it to myself.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: By the way, what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to meet Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Now is the time for you to come.
(When Aurum looks up, he sees Michaela flying from afar. Michaela seems to recognize the visitor and approaches him with a smile.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s I’m glad you came, Mika… , what's the matter? Uh, %s… . what? This feather... . This is a battle angel... .
(Michaela removes the wing feathers from %s's clothes. The feathers are similar to Michaela's, but a bit rougher.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, have you met Rafi?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, how did we meet? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Michaela about meeting the Battle Angel at the Aegir Ruins.)
(Tears form in the eyes of Michaela, who rarely shows any other expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is okay. When Mika heard that Rafi had reappeared, he stopped… . I'm so happy... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The day the continent was destroyed, I thought Rafi disappeared... .
(Michaela wipes her tears and plays with the wing feathers of another battle angel.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The gods went to the Atlas Garden in pursuit of the twisted man who was trying to escape to the Demon World, and Rafi was waiting nearby... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A garden?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Atlas Garden… . I've never been to Mika, but I know it contains God's truth.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I don't know why the twisted one went to the garden, but it's obvious... . He must have tried to get his hands on the truth... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: All the gods who went there perished. To the Beast whom Iris called the Demon King... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I thought Rafi was like that too... . Ah, this is not the time to be like this. Mika will help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?
(Mikaela approaches %s and gives him a light kiss on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela. You were surprised.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Are you surprised again? Isn't it time to get used to Mika?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, sorry. But, wow, it was so sudden… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s will be fine as long as you stay safe in the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’ll decline… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Michaela? These are Michaela's wing feathers.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Before, I gave it to you if you fought Mika, but I won't do that today. Show the Mika feather to Rafi. And call me by my real name.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Rafaella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Then Rafi will help %s.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I want to go with you, but I can't. I’m sorry Mika… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I will quickly go and tell Raffaella’s story about Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later then. Aurum, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Hello, %s.
(Michaela waves her hand and sees Adventurer off as she leaves Sanctuary Eidos.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'm glad that the angel who disappeared has appeared.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I'm glad Mikado Rafi came back alive... . however… , what happened to the garden… .

steps.name: The Way of the Battle Angel
steps.objective: Defeat [Rafaella] at “Aegir Ruins” and report the quest to [Juen].

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: %s, when did you come?
(Juen closes the book he was reading and approaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just now. What happened so far? Strange sounds are heard from within the ruins... .

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Yeah, there was nothing like that. If that were the case, I wouldn't be here comfortably reading a book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Hmm, not yet?
(Juen tilts his head at %s’s actions as he looks around.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Yes? Not yet?
(Somehow, Pandora appears behind Juen and extends her hand to %s, gesturing for her to enter the Aegir Ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow… . Adventurer, isn’t this so cool?!
(Juen’s eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: You were checking your own timing. What a great adventure it took you to realize that?

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: It's so cool. Plus, the humility of saying it’s nothing… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s difficult to explain, so I have to go quickly….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Juen, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the historic site is noisy, quickly go to the village. Okay? Because it could become dangerous.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: I'll keep that in mind, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will go straight into the ruins. Juen, see you later.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: So, happy exploring, Adventurer!
(When Juen said hello, Hepring, who was lying down and eating a snack, also waved his front paw and said hello.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… . Let’s go now… .
(As you enter the ruins, Pandora stares at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … It seems like your mood has changed a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Battle Angel in Sanctuary showed me how. right. You said you were looking at the roads. Has there been any harvest?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That… .
(The moment Pandora is about to answer, a strong wind blows from inside the ruins.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This time, the wind caused by the battle angel... . Unlike before, I feel fine.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This must be because of the way you figured it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.
(%s The battle angel appears to have noticed that the party has withstood the blowing wind, and approaches, flapping its wings.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Mika? It's not Mika... . How did you get Mika’s power…? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella, I have something to say, so please listen.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I know what Micah's feather on your hand means. But, Rafi can’t admit it yet.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So, fight Rafi one more time. So that Rafi can admit it... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Because this is the method of battle angels like Mika and Rafi. And not here. If your and Rafi's powers collide here, the magic concentrated here will explode.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Because this is that kind of place. It's not close to the garden... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then where should I go?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You know where I fought before? It's the widest and deepest place, so go there. I'll go first and wait for you.
(Rafaella, who heard the answer with %s's nod, quickly goes inside.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's a bit annoying, but I'll help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I will do it. I, who possess Mikaela's feather, must fight Rafaella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the battle angel's way... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I understand. If that's the angel's way... . Instead, I will take the lead there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Pandora.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we go?
(The moment the battle angel makes eye contact, a sharp attack comes towards %s.)
(Everything in the ruins shakes as Rafaella and %s's attacks collide with all their might.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I happen to see followers of God fighting.
(As the battle drags on, battle angel Rafaella's face shows signs of fatigue. %s's strong attack comes in front of Rafaella, who is taking a moment to catch her breath.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Is it over... .
(Battle Angel Rafaella blocked %s's attack, but she fell backwards as she lost all her strength.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Hahahaha, Rafi lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay. I'm just so weak that I can't get up. Give me your hand for a moment.
(Rafaella stands up, holding %s's hand with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks like nothing is wrong...)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Again, Rafi is fine. Rafi probably misunderstood because you were the one who said you liked Mika, right? Now, give Rafi the Mika feather.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for clearing up the misunderstanding. here… .
(Rafaella receives Michaela's feather from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella, can I call you by your name now?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I already called your name. There's one more left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Raphaela approaches %s and kisses her cheek like Michaela.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, no, I was surprised.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi's greetings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, how much more do I have to do to get used to it... ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's popular with angels... . By the way, Rafi? Rafaella? Battle Angel… . I have something I want to ask.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: You seem like a demon, but is it okay for Rafi to think of you as a friend of Mika's friend?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A friend of a friend? Well, it’s similar… . Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi was waiting here before going to the Atlas Garden as ordered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I guess I should explain that… . Rafaela, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a long time since Rafaela and Michaela haven't seen each other. A thousand years? Or maybe it was more… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: No, even a few days ago… .
(Rafaella lowers her head as if she realized something.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Somehow... , something was strange. There was nothing near the river here.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I was chasing a twisted person with hidden powers around the Atlas Garden and was resting nearby... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Suddenly darkness came.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: And then I heard God scream… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It sounded so terrible that Rafi thought it was a dream... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: BEAST… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: A dream might be better. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't get out.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Then I saw you guys. I thought you were preventing me from leaving.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi, don’t you think I’m stupid? A battle angel who is supposed to protect God wants to believe it was a dream even after hearing God's screams... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Because God has never screamed like that... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Uh, this light... .
(A small sphere of light appears next to Rafaella, who was grieving, and begins to circle.)
(The moment Rafaella receives the approaching small light in her hands, a small voice comforting her rings out.)
It's not Rafaela's fault.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ceres… ? no. It's not Ceres' voice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raphaella, this voice is Iris, who succeeded Ceres as the star god.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: What about Ceres? Ceres… … .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I'm sorry, Rafaella... . I don't have time to explain at length, so instead I'll give you some memories of the world that reached the Great Wall.
(With the words of Iris, the light that remained in Rafaela's hands rises. The rising light circles around Rafaela as if surrounding it.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ah… . ah… . A lot happened while Rafi was away... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ceres, Gaia… , Iris… .
(Rafaella cries like a child while holding on to Lance. A small light hovers next to her as if comforting her, then stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… . What happens to Rafaella now?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Now, the two battle angels are bound to this land by a strong fate... . Michaela is in the Sanctuary, Rafaela is around the Aegir Ruins... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi, can’t I get out of here?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: That's not it. It's not like I can get out of here right now, but I promise. I'll let you meet Michaela at the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Thank you, Iris! Rafi can wait!

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: I am more grateful. and… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: At the time, I never imagined that a child from the Der tribe would end up like this... . I'll say hello later.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Yes, Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Rafaella, %s… . This light will soon disappear. I was in a hurry so I couldn't prepare properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. As soon as we find Levy... . ah… .
(Before %s finished speaking, the small light in Rafaella's hand evaporated.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: … Ah, I wanted to talk a little more... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Angel, have you ever seen anyone but me and %s?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi couldn't see anyone else... . uh?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: No one has seen it, but I felt a very strong force and hid myself. It's different from the energy you guys have... .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: It was a power that was neither demonic nor divinely protected. The power disappeared right away, so I went and saw something like this.
(Pandora is surprised to see the items she received from Rafaella.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw it when I went to the Poe Mansion. this… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Before I fought you, I had a bad energy here. But not now. Even if it is, it’s just an empty box… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But why is Levy… . Where the hell have you gone... . Levy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, calm down.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can't do that. What I can do in this situation is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me help you. That's why I came here.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, I am… .
(The moment Pandora is about to say something, the quiet Aegir Ruins begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi will go out and check. Iris said it would be okay if it was near a historical site.
(Rafaella flaps her wings vigorously and flies towards the outside of the ruins at high speed. However, she must have hit something and bounces back inside.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Ugh… , what, what? But this… .
(The moment Rafaella tries to fly out again, she suddenly falls to the floor.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella? Rafaella!!

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I'm out of strength... . ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rafi is okay... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Angel, what's out there?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Garden… .

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I saw the Atlas Garden. There, the power of the twisted one and other powers are mixed and shaking... . Rafi is blocking me from getting closer... .
(Rafaella continues speaking with difficulty.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rafaella is here. Pandora, do you have something to say to me?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll go and check it out.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: … Be careful, that place... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard an explanation from Michaela. First, we'll check what happened outside, so in the meantime, Rafaella, please rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay here, right?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I think I can recover... . Rafi, I'll rest here. Sorry. Because it wasn't helpful... .
(Rafaella falls asleep with her eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, follow me. I have work to do there. ah… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You have work to do first. Tell the child in front of the ruins to go back to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. But where are you going?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The vacant lot where I met Daphne.
(Pandora finishes speaking and quickly walks toward the exit of the ruins.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The garden Rafaella mentioned… Well, I guess I have no choice but to check it with my own eyes... ?

steps.name: Daphne's real purpose
steps.objective:
1. After talking with [Juen] in “Laran Road,” go to “Laran Road Vacant Lot.” 
2. Check out what is happening at the “Laran Road Vacant Area” and report the quest to [Pandora] in front of the entrance to the “Atlas Garden” on “Laran Road”.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Adventurer, are you finished?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's somewhat over.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Does that mean there is something else left?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said, Juen is not allowed in. There are still a lot of dangerous things.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Now that you say that, I'm even more curious, but as Adventurer said, I don't plan on going inside the historic site for a few years.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Even if you don't have experience now, you can gain it later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Juen. I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: What is it, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't ask me why now, but I want you to go back to the village right away.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Instead, when I finish all my work and return to the village, I will tell Juen an interesting story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: While traveling around various areas in Eastland, I met superhumans... .
(Juen’s eyes sparkle as he listens to the story.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow… . Wow wow wow! Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you something like an Eastland souvenir as a gift.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer, you're awesome. It's absolutely the best. Well, then I'll go home right away. I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: promise.

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Wow, Heffling! Did you hear? Did you hear?
(Hepring looks at Juen with a completely clueless expression and falls down again.)

lines.speaker: 쥬엔
lines.text: Hehe, Adventurer. Well then, take care of your business and come straight to my house. Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Juen.
(Juen walks quickly towards the village with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that thing in the sky over there? I didn't see it when I first came here... . That means that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Atlas Garden… .

lines.speaker: %s
