lines.text: I can't do it. We need to get to where Pandora is quickly. I hope this doesn't end up putting the village in danger... .
(Pandora looks at the sky in the clearing and smiles bitterly at the sight of %s approaching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… ?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Suddenly I felt like I was being used... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To whom?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A being that wants to use everyone in this world, including me and you, like pieces on a chessboard... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm going to tell my story to you who believed in me and helped me. Will you listen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(With %s's answer, darkness gathers around Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This is a shadow that has no effect on you... . You don't have to be scared.
(As Pandora laughs lightly, the shadow surrounding the two becomes darker, leaving only sound.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A story about a witch, a story about Levi... , and the reason why I try to approach the night… . Which story would you like to hear first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What kind of story do you want to hear?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As you know, I am Agashura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Most of Agashura are a group called sinners. Sinners who die by committing a sin wish to die as is, but some are unable to die and end up continuing to commit that sin.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So are all the sinners you know. Me too... . Let’s postpone talking about what the crime is until later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A being who can live only by committing eternal sins. Even being reborn was not allowed. If you want to end this life, you have no choice but to grant someone else's wish and disappear... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: From the moment I became Agashura, I didn't want to stay long. So I tried to disappear, but at some point, a different fate took hold of me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The life of a witch who has no choice but to approach at night... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The Etoile gods had the power to intervene in life, but they did not touch it directly. But the Goddess of the Black Moon… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Hecate's name flowing from your lips... . I guess we've already met. Yes, I assumed that if Daphne had met him, she would know something about Hecate.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Yes, Hecate had a hand in the fate of many, including me. If it had the power of a god, it could have been a blessing, but it was a curse.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Killing and killing each other and surviving within it... . Because the cursed had to survive to escape the curse... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So I told you not to get involved, right? Everyone involved is dead... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, so just in case... . Just in case… . What happens when only the last witch remains?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm not sure because they haven't all died yet, but they will become something close to gods. Because a dead witch's abilities belong to the person who killed her... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Morgana's powers went to Daphne... . Ah, then Pandora’s ability is… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: None of the witches want my powers. Because it is Agashura’s life itself… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: However, I have no intention of becoming the last witch. Levy wouldn't want that... .
(Pandora hesitates for a moment when trying to hear the story about Levy. However, she opens her mouth as if she wants to tell the story properly.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Unlike other Agashura members who went all over the continent to do bad things, I was always at the mansion.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Because I didn't want to commit a crime by looking for it. Then I found the perfect place for a witch who had no choice but to commit a crime.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Poe Mansion… . A suspicious mansion left behind by wizard Alan. Bampanella, who had been sleeping in the coffin, woke up and volunteered to be a servant.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And we spread the word and attracted many people. If you meet a great witch in the Gothic Room, she will grant you your wish... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It was a good choice. Because Bampanella needed blood, and I was Agashura.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: People who came to make trivial wishes died in front of the Gothic Room before they could make a wish. I thought I was a weak being. Just greedy... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then one day. A man arrived in front of the Gothic Room, bleeding. I was interested in him because he seemed like an incredibly strong person when he met me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The young man presented the baby to me at the door of death.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The child had a short time left to live. I will give my life, so please save the child, he screamed.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Actually, I wasn't interested in any of people's wishes, but it was different back then. The sound of a baby's laughter as it woke up and looked at its father captivated me.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I spoke to the young man. Ask for the child and your soul. The young man hesitated, but said he would understand. Instead, I will give it to you when you leave at the end of your life.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That was okay. Because I had no business dealing with souls anyway.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: However, the young man hesitated somewhere else. I guess I couldn't bear to see my child lose his deep emotions and bright smile instead of living again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The young man must have wanted to save his child somehow. In the end, I had no choice but to decide on my own.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As the child's smile disappeared, I realized something, but I thought it wasn't a big deal and moved on.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That's how the baby survived, and as promised, he lost his deep emotions. I have become a baby who no longer cries.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: This is the story of Levi and his father, Lian... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Father and son Ahrens were bound by a contract with me, but I don't think they thought of it as a curse. This is just my opinion, but... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I wonder what I was so thankful for, so they kept coming to me. That's how I got to see Levy grow up.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Then one day, Levy came to me and said this. He said he would go on a journey to find the Demon King with a girl from the Der tribe... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Agashura instinctively knows Iris. Because he is the only survivor of a sacred clan that has the power to prevent those who have sinned from sinning again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: So, as Agash, it is not strange if I receive the judgment of the new star god right away. I don't know how many Der people died by my hands... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But, there is something to do before that. That's why I try to approach the night.
(Pandora raises her head and looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: After Levy left, I had a strange feeling for a while. I had no idea what it was, but I figured it out quickly.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That Levy was killed by the Demon King... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Only then did I realize it. The fact that all the power related to Agashura flows to the Demon Lord... .  Everything, including Levy's soul, is tied to me... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It'll be hard to understand. Because right now, I feel like this world without the devil is complicated.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: But, Levy came back. Neither the soul nor the body perishes... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, do you know?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The reason Beast was reborn as the Demon King was because he was fused with the soul of the perfect Der people.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The reason Levy was sick was because her soul was not absorbed by the Demon King... . It's because I'm an imperfect soul.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This, this… . It doesn't make sense. Why is this happening... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (After barely calming down his turbulent emotions, he tells Pandora about what happened with Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The beings above are causing excruciating pain to the life of this world.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levy would also break down if she met someone whose soul had a similar color. And I am also bound by a contract... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: From the moment I touched the souls of Lian and Levy, they were already acting according to the will of the beings above... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: The transcendent one who sent me here... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I don't want to lose Levy to that guy. So I'm going to make Levy's soul perfect.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Giving back emotions and being able to live properly as a human being... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: All you have to do is find a witch with the ability to fuse souls, kill her, and receive that ability... , I'll find another way.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Never do it in a way that Levy doesn't like... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You care about Levy a lot.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Ah, rather than caring about each other, it's a relationship connected by a contract, so I have to keep the contract... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: As a contractor, it is natural to protect Levy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't panic because I know what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Uh, huh?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Anyway, I think the method I want is there. Covering the truth of the ugly world... .
(Pandora, looking at the sky, quietly gestures to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Someone has been here from the beginning. I can't believe I didn't notice anything while I was talking to you... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll have to see who's there... .
(With a gesture of Pandora's hand, the darkness around them disappears. And in the midst of it, an unexpected person shows an embarrassed expression.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, why are you here?
%s? %s? Please save me!!

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Who are you?
I am the inspector of the Gendia Empire, Levi... .
(Pandora's face hardens upon hearing Inspector Levi's name.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Damn… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Give me another name instead of that one!!
Yes, yes, yes... ? Not Levy, ah, ah… . Te, it's a presentation.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Okay, Tation. Tell me why you are here.

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: There was a request from the Empire, so I was on my way to Glaston first. However, a woman with rabbit ears suddenly appears and asks if she would like to become a servant... .

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: When I asked what he was talking about, he said it was a joke and made me unable to move. I don't really remember what happened after that... .

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: When I opened my eyes, it was here. The two of you were talking and I shouted for help, but you couldn't understand... .
(Pandora's angry voice shakes the clearing. Then, the surrounding scenery breaks into pieces, as if broken glass, falling to the ground one by one.)
(After all the pieces fall, a woman with bunny ears pricking up appears from behind with a smile on her face.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: After all, you are no ordinary witch. Agashura Pandora.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: What are you thinking?
(Daphne looks at the fallen Station with a sad expression. However, when the tip of the weapon full of hostility is pointed at her, she shifts her gaze to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, where is Levy?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Haven't I told you? I have no business with you here. Hehehe.
(Daphne pushes %s's weapon away with the tip of her staff.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, I want to hear your answer.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: First, tell me what you did with Levy.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Heh… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The person you are looking for is wandering up there in the Atlas Garden, floating in the sky. I thought you were there.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Then let me tell you my story, Pandora... . I need you. Let's greet the night together.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will give you this as a gift, so come to me. For your beloved Levy. As if their souls were one from the beginning... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Kill it.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I don't do that. Levy says she won't do anything she doesn't want to do.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm thinking of opening the box in the garden.

lines.text: It can't be helped. Thank you, it's annoying, but I'll give you something to do. %s, this is new to you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(Daphne looks with satisfaction at Theation flying up into the sky and then slowly backs away.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Those with souls of the same color will soon meet, Pandora. I don’t have to tell you the result, right?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Those with weak souls will die.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Okay, everyone. Come to the garden.
(With those words, Daphne disappears from the vacant lot without a trace.)
(As Daphne disappears, the anxious energy surrounding the vacant lot disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne is like this again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It must have been this way from the beginning.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, I have to go to the garden quickly… . I was planning on going from the beginning, but now there is no need to hesitate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But there is something I want to know. What is a box in the garden?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Records left by the gods about life and soul.
(As soon as Pandora answers %s's question, she hurries out of the clearing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So that's the legacy of the gods... Is it okay to search for it like this?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Saving people comes first... everyone, just wait a moment...)

lines.text: (A large water drop floats in front of Pandora and is shaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, there you are. Could this be… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: That's right. Gate to Atlas Garden. I think it was because of the garden that the Aesar River possessed such tremendous magical power.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll put other questions aside.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If you encounter these water droplets that are beating like a heart, you will be able to go to the garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Come on, let's go. To the Garden of the Gods... .
(When Pandora extends her hand, the turbulent water droplets spread out as if they had been waiting. And they swallow the two people heading to a place they were not invited to.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Has it arrived?
(The water droplets surrounding the two people disperse and a true scene unfolds before their eyes.)
(A windmill-like structure is attached to an unpretentious building and is moving. Below it, a large water tank supports everything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating. There is a place like this... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can't believe I'm amazed by something like this... . There's still a long way to go. There are more parts of the world that you don't know, and it's bigger and deeper.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: A place that is not only cool, but cold... . What did the gods put here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Pandora… . There's someone over there.
(As %s looks around, he sees someone approaching in the distance.)
(A boy with bandages on his face and legs runs to %s's side with a happy expression.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I am not an ordinary person. be careful.
Nice to meet you. I was already waiting. This is Atlas Garden. This is where the truth of the gods lies.
Hmm, actually, it's a place only people in the know know about. Ah, it is a place known only to God and not to people.
Like it or not, only those who are related to God can come here.
A person like you who received God's protection, or a witch who received a useless fate due to God's prank... .
Actually, if you look at it, it's the remnants of the Beast that ate the gods.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Oh, I know you guys, but you don't know me, so I guess I should tell you?
Witch, tell me the name that comes to your mind.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Menoiti?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now, wait a minute. This is... similar to when I met Hecate. However, I don't feel any greater power than then.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: My name is Menoiti. Simply call it Meno. If you call me E.T., I'll get angry.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … I see that you are asked to call the name that comes to mind. You are a god.
(Menoiti smiles brightly at the calm Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Yeah. A long time ago I was called God. Somehow I ended up being called a twisted person again.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: God and humans, you can't like everything. I only said no a few times... . ha.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: There are many pretty names in the world, but there is something twisted about them. Look carefully. Does this pretty me look distorted?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Meno, so what are you going to do with us?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Did you think that I would do anything because I am a person with a twisted name and appearance? Hehe, that's the correct answer.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You're being selfish.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: It's been a while since I woke up in a world where my friends have been eaten or run away, so shouldn't I do everything I can?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: The remnants of a Beast born from Hecate's curse. Ah, it's really cool to call it like that. I'll just call her a witch. Witch Pandora.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What you are looking for is here. But what should I do? As the Atlas Garden awakened, the gardener also awakened again.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Gardener?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Metheus the gardener cuts down anyone who covets the truth and soul of the world. Even if it was God who gave him the sharp edge.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What is the truth that they wanted to hide so much that even the gods would kill it? Aren’t you curious?

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: At that time, I risked my life to find it and go to the demon world. Because the Demon World was safer than dying from the Beast.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: They brought all the Battle Angels and Saint Valkyries to catch me. Moreover, the gardener was also upset.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: What… . Since everything has failed now, I'm going to quit everything and have fun. The gardener must have found out that I quit, so he didn't say anything to me.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: There is no Beast, and there is no one to kill me, so there is no need to struggle. I won't even be greedy.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Instead, I'll play around with the gardener while you guys are here. Please understand that.
(Menoiti finishes talking to himself and raises a glass that looks like a chalice. Then, the glass that was empty a moment ago is filled with clean water.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Star of twisted fate.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: A star destined for destruction that everyone loved and praised.

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Menoiti, who loved you, says... .
(As Menoiti continues speaking, the water in the glass begins to stir and takes on the shape of a dragon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… . This feeling... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: God comes... .
(Pandora and %s feel a sense of paralyzing fear, but it soon dissipates.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: Ah… . What happened next? Eh, I don't know.
(Menoiti laughs and drinks the water that was stirring in the glass just moments ago.)

lines.speaker: 메노이티
lines.text: I'll play around a bit today and then go back. So please don't hate me too much.
(Menoiti drinks and spills the remaining water on the floor. Then, the water droplets that bounce off the floor surround Menoiti and disappear.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: They are determined to interfere. Levy… , Levy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I can feel Levy's energy over there. It's over there.
(As Pandora is looking at one place, a voice that appears to be Levi is heard from afar.)

lines.speaker: 레비의 목소리
lines.text: “Pandora, please don’t make bad choices in the belief that you are doing it for me… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this Levy's voice?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's definitely true. It's Levy's voice. How did it get here? Could it be that Daphne... .
(Pandora hurries forward with shaking eyes. %s follows behind as Pandora runs ahead without a chance to say anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… .
(While checking all the paths and structures in the Atlas Garden, he continues to be chased by beings within the garden, including the Twisted One.)
(After avoiding enemies for a while and wading through rough spray, you finally arrive at the last corner of the space that you couldn't check.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, it seems like this is the only place left... . There's nothing.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … There's a hidden wall. I can feel Levy after this… .
(When Pandora extends her hand, a wall that was previously invisible appears. As soon as it appears, the wall collapses.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levy, Levy... . It should be here... . Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: I'm fine, but he... . Was her name Pandora?

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: I've heard of it. A witch who lives in a remote mansion and kills people using wishes as bait... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You can think about it anyway.

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: Where are we now? I heard that there was a fight between witches that your Majesty once spoke about... . Why are you using me in that fight?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know that you shouldn't know anything about His Majesty. Maybe that's why Daphne brought you here... .

lines.speaker: 테이션
lines.text: So, have you found Levy from Elias?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't found it yet... .
(Suddenly, a sharp and strong spray of water appears in front of %s, tying up the station and sending it flying into the sky.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm not usually the type of person to recommend something again, but I'd like to say it one more time.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Come to me. Let's spend the night together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, ignore Daphne's story... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Can I put a condition on it?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: As long as it's good for you.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: We'll only cooperate until Levy's soul becomes whole... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora? What are you talking about? Suddenly collaborating with Daphne?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, do you trust me? Agashura and me, the witch... . I… .
Click, click.
(Before Pandora can finish speaking, the sound of something that resembles a mechanical device is heard from somewhere in an irregular manner.)
(People in the same space naturally turn their heads in the direction from which the sound is coming.)
(A being that is neither a bird nor a human nor a machine flies in front of everyone, cutting through the water droplets hovering in the Atlas Garden.)
(A bizarre being whose beautiful silver-grey body is filled with sharp, pointed thorns looks around.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Metheus the Gardener... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus… ?
(When God's creature without any expression extends its hand, a fan with a sharp blade that did not exist before is created.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「▒Li of the ▒world… “You who covet the spirit.”
(Metheus' voice echoes in the Atlas Garden, mixed with strange sounds.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, that's a lot of power... . Well, I can't even stand properly.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「I will ▒sim▒ you. Do not open the ▒ri of the ▒frame▒jeong▒... .」
(As Metheus swings his fan, a sharp wind passes by %s.)
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak.
(The structure in the garden that the wind touches is destroyed and falls straight down. Every time the structure falls into the river, a large whirlpool of water arises and reaches the garden.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: You who desire the truth and soul of the world, I will test you on behalf of God. To prevent us from opening the truth of the Atlas Garden... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Who is the judge of the created being? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… .
(Metheus looks at the two people and opens his fan wide.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: %s, do you trust me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I believe it… , I was able to come this far.
(%s's answer was ambiguous, but Pandora still gave a small smile as if she was satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Got it. Well then, let's take down the gardener together for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's dangerous because if the garden is destroyed, it could fall into the village.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: After all, you are different from me. Anyway, deal with Daphne after that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne has already disappeared with Levy, or rather, Tation. I mean, I'm going to watch.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I really don't like it. Well, that's how I could have survived.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. %s… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I also believe in you and will do something. So, I hope you trust me until the end... . There may be some parts that I don't understand... .
(The moment Pandora's eyes turn to Metheus, a purple glowing magic circle unfolds beneath Metheus' feet.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Just as you believe in Iris... . Just like I care about Levy... .
(At that moment, a sharp whirlpool arises from Metheus' blade fan and heads toward Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Metheus' movements have slowed down, %s.
(Pandora continues to spread a magic circle around the garden to prevent the remains of the garden destroyed by Metheus' attack from falling into the river.)
(Metheus rotates sharply and prepares to create a large wind again. At that time, %s's attack, which was looking for an opportunity, touches Metheus' fan of blades.)
Ku-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa!
(The moment the two powerful forces collide, a large stream of water rises from the river as if flowing backwards, covering the garden.)
(Pandora hurriedly throws the remains of the garden into an empty space. It then flies towards %s, who loses his balance and slips due to the waves hitting the garden.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Take my hand!!
(Pandora snatches %s's hand at high speed and rises into the air, and the movement of the water that had been turbulent just now stops.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to you, I survived.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Metheus stopped moving... . Let’s take a quick look… .
(Pandora looks down at Metheus from the air and comes down with Adventurer.)
(The fallen Metheus does not move when he sees the two people approaching him. It looks as if he is waiting as if he has something to say.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know that God's creatures will not stop protecting the garden like this. So say what you want to say.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… “I learned that there is no one here who covets the truth.”

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: There is no such thing as truth here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora, that?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Continue listening to Metheus' story.

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: 「… I found out that it was not the world of gods I knew... . Follower of God. I judged wrong. The truth here is... .」
(As Metheus was about to say something, his limbs and wings were broken by some force. Perhaps because of the impact, he stopped moving and fell down.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: He is the one who knows the whereabouts of truth. all. print. yes!!!!
(With Pandora's cry, a magic circle is created behind %s, and a powerful explosion of magic occurs within it.)
(After a while, Daphne slowly appears in front of the two people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!
(Adventurer raises his weapon towards the approaching Daphne, but Daphne's staff taps him on the shoulder first.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Stop.
(With one word from Daphne, %s's movement to escape stops.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No, my body doesn’t move.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I thought everything would stop, but somehow only my spirit survives... . Medea, I never thought that child would save you like this.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora can't save you now. Because I temporarily locked your presence behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I know very well that just as you couldn't do anything, Pandora can't do anything. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Daphne… , How many witches have you killed to have this ability?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Come on, Pandora. Since you still seem like you can't decide, let me give you a little help.
(A familiar voice is heard from somewhere along with Daphne's smile.)

lines.speaker: 레비의 목소리
lines.text: “Pandora… . I am Pandora... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Levi..., where is Levy?)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … Levy, trust me. Okay, Daphne.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes, Pandora. Looking at your expression, I see you have made up your mind. Now, tell me the conditions.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Make a contract with me that you will never touch Levy.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It's a contract with Agashura... . However, the conditions will be different.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: If it's me who gets what you wish for, I'll risk your life in return. I put in a condition that it doesn't matter if I die if I touch Levy.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: And I will be with you until Levy's soul is made whole.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe, there are a lot of unexpected conditions, but it’s a good deal.
(Daphne taps the floor with her wand while smiling in satisfaction. After a moment, a large water droplet floats, bursts, and drops the Tation inside it to the floor.)
(Pandora creates a magic circle that appears to be Agashura's magic. Then, she cuts her hand and lets the blood drip into the magic circle.)
(Daphne, who was watching the magic circle that drank the blood become hot, approaches.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, let me ask you just one question. Agashura's contract is absolute, right?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: It's like the curse of the transcendent, the Etoire god can never touch it... .
(For a moment, Daphne's expression changes. A surprised Pandora tries to grab Daphne, but Daphne has already appeared from behind the station.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It's great. Pandora.
(With those words, thick branches grown from Daphne's cane protrude from Sean's abdomen. A moment later, Sean falls to the bottom of the garden along with the cut branches.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Oh no… . Ugh, ugh… . Aaaaaaa!!
(Blood rises from the magic circle that turns blood red and falls on Pandora's face.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Pandora!! Pandora!! What happened? We have to get out of here!!)
(Daphne looks alternately at the suffering Pandora and %s.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, Agashura's contract is absolute. That's what it looks like now... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No way. I can't return to my beast form here... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora, calm down.
(Daphne taps Pandora's shoulder with her cane. After a while, Pandora, screaming in pain, collapses on the spot.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This allows you to come with me. And %s, now that we're done, come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne!! What on earth did you do to Pandora? Uh, uh….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mo, my body is moving. Hey, Pandora, are you okay?
(Pandora looks at %s's face again and looks sad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm sorry, you trusted me, but I made a mistake... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora will come with me now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of nonsense is that?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Gambling with one's life as collateral seems to be a characteristic of Agashura. Hehehe. You can't believe they added one more condition to the contract in such a short period of time.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If Pandora herself touches someone with a soul of the same color as Levy, she wants the witch bound by the contract to die as well... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora made a contract with herself, stipulating that she would stay with me until Levy's soul became whole.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So I checked the contract again. Because Agashura's contract is absolute. So I'll leave Levy as is for now. To prevent Pandora from leaving... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Such nonsense... .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Such absurd things happen even to gods, and there is no law preventing them from happening to Agashura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm doing exactly what Hecate said...)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Pandora… . I sent Sean's soul to a safe place I know. Do you know what this means?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The story is that Levy could face death in an incomplete state at any time.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Well, stop… … . Oh, okay… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Please follow me quietly. Because that's the only way you and Levy can survive.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: By the way, I only made Levy's voice appropriately, but I can't believe I faked it. Pandora, you are so… .

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Oh, the real Levy is coming over there right now.
(The real Levy, dressed as a traveler, runs towards this place at high speed from where Daphne is pointing.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Free Pandora immediately!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy?
(The moment Levi's spear of Bironta touches Daphne's neck, Daphne lowers her head and smiles softly.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No way, Levy!!!!!!!
Boom.
(Levi falls down on the spot with a loud sound. %s is also pushed back by the strong impact.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. Like this again...

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Where has Pandora gone? Where on earth is that witch... .
(Levi looks around with blank eyes, but there is nothing in front of him.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, is this a witch's ability?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Some of Daphne's abilities were obtained by killing other witches... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Okay. We need to find Pandora quickly... .
(Levi stops and looks to one side.)
Click, click.
(The sound of a mechanical device running erratically is heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Metheus… ?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: That… .
(The arms, legs, and wings of Metheus, who had fallen, were twisted in an unknown process and then returned to their original form.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It's not an ordinary monster. %s, how do I deal with that?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Everyone in the garden, listen... . “The witch has disappeared.”

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “The witch erased your memories and disappeared… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I assumed that would be the case. But how do you remember that?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “I am a being created by the gods from the great wall... … . I just borrowed the memories contained in the stars... .」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “And with my current consciousness, I no longer fight.”
(Metheus stands up and looks blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “In some ways, the reason why the gods fought in two and why the living fight doesn’t seem to be any different… . 」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Because those who exist must prove themselves… . 」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Followers of God.”

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “I have nothing more to protect. “There is no point in existing because there is nothing to protect.”

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “In a world where even foolish truths have disappeared… .」

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “Follower of God. Do you want the Black Moon to become the truth of the world?”

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Black moon… , black moon?

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “The garden will remain here and look down. “If you come here again, you will have to be prepared to destroy this body like you did now.”

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “If you don’t want to follow the will of someone who doesn’t love the world… .」
(Metheus finishes speaking and slowly rises into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait!! Don't go yet. I have something to ask… .
(The rising Metheus looks down at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 메테우스
lines.text: “I will answer only what I know.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the garden disappear and reappear?
(The moment Metheus opens his mouth, Levy is in pain.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Uuuuuuuuuuu... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy, hurry and cover your ears!!
(With those words, Metheus flies into the sky and disappears without looking back.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s, what did that monster say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can't hear God's language unless you allow it.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: God's language... . That means that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is a creature created by the gods to protect the truth of this place... . and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Levy everything about coming to Laran Road at the request of Iris and meeting Pandora.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … You said so.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora is for me... . Even so, such a choice... .
(Levi, who heard the whole story, lowers his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, how did Levy come here? They say that only those who are related to God can come here... .
(Levi takes out a pure white feather from his arms in response to %s's question.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: A witch named Daphne tricked me and locked me in the back of the Aegir Ruins, saying she wanted to kill Pandora.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: The angel somehow knew, so he found me and brought me out right away... . Checking if %s is the levi you were looking for... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: And he gave me this and told me to go to the garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do now….)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: %s… . Wow, I can feel Pandora’s magic nearby.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Levi raises his head and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I need to go outside.
(As soon as Levy finishes speaking, he quickly runs in the direction he came from.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's true that Levy is connected to Pandora's magic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know... . Let's go first. If you go, you'll find out something.

steps.name: pandora's box
steps.objective: Talk to [Pandora] in “Laran Road” and report the quest to [Yeonhee] in “Lulia Village.”

lines.text: (As we follow Levy through the water droplets floating around the garden, the image of Laran Road gets closer.)
(And then we arrive at the place where we first entered the garden.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought there would still be large water droplets that were there when I entered the garden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Levy?
(Pandora, who had disappeared from the garden, appears next to Levy, who is staring at one place.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Even in this situation, Levy still cares about me... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Sorry for coming so late... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: No, I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'm sorry to both Levy and %s.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I made a wrong choice and opened something I shouldn't have opened.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I shouldn't have gone to the garden... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Still, I'm glad I was able to say hello before I left... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I know what to say. Because Agashura's contract is real... , I can't help it.
(Pandora, unable to hide her lonely eyes, quietly pulls Levy's hand. Levy knows Pandora's intentions, so she quietly entrusts her hands to her.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levy… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I'll be back. I promise... .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: … There may be no way with Agashura's contract, but there may be a way with the witch's abilities.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Although I will be dragged around by Daphne until then... .
(Pandora trails off and pushes away Levy's hands.)

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Stop now... . And, %s. Theation's body has gone elsewhere, so it won't be found here. I hope I can find it later... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I didn't want that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was nothing we could do.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Thank you… . For believing in me until the end... .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Levy… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Go back to Gndia right away.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Pandora… .

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: I wish Levy would go back to Giendia. Then, you will be able to wait for Levy comfortably at the mansion at any time.

lines.speaker: 판도라
lines.text: Because I haven’t given up hope yet… .
(When Pandora turns her back, a dark shadow approaches as if it had been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: … Pandora!!
(Levi reached out for Pandora, but Pandora was swallowed up in the darkness and disappeared.)

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: It can't be like this... . We finally met again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy… .
(Levi looks blankly at the spot where Pandora disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levy, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: I'm fine. I'm worried about Pandora... . %s, I'm going back to Elias.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Ah, thank you… .

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Because it's a promise to Pandora... . You don't have to worry about the rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 레비
lines.text: Then, please ask %s and Iris. And see you later.
(Levi bows his head and hurries off somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looking at the results, it seems like Iris did as requested... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pandora is like that, and Metheus's words are also caught... .
「It’s ▒New Year▒time▒▒… … .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because the gods betrayed life... .
(If you look up and look up, there is still a garden with an ominous atmosphere floating in the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much is this world hiding? . Phew, Iris… . How much more do we have to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to the village first... . People will be confused just by the appearance of the garden... .

steps.name: A garden that never disappears
steps.objective: Finish talking with [Yeonhee] and [Helena] in “Lulia Village” and report the quest to [Helena].

lines.text: (Yeonhee quietly looks up at the sky and looks around. When it seems like a familiar person is passing her by, she softly calls her name.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Yeonhee. Are you here?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Did you find Levy?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I was able to find it quickly.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: But why are you coming alone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's because Levy was busy and met me right away... , Elias I returned to the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing much has happened in the village so far, right?

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: What's going on?
(Yeonhee looks like she has no idea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think Yeonhee knew either…. If she had noticed something, the village wouldn’t have been quiet….)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Like Aie Island... . Oops, I promised, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: So are they talking about this... .
(On the side where Yeonhee is looking, people who do not appear to be villagers are standing in a group.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: I think they are wizards belonging to the Magic Agency of the Sylvaria Empire and knights belonging to the council.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are those people here... .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Well, I don't know. I'm fine... .
(Yeonhee looks like she has no idea. Then she smiles brightly as if something occurred to her.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: By the way, %s. Leon invited me to dinner, would you like to come with me?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'm sorry, lady.
(Helena appears at some point and grabs %s's wrist.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Elderly?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Adventurer has a prior contract. With this person… . I must have lost track of time and only now found out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s may have a lot of time, but this person doesn't have much time left. So you should have come quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Helena. Don't say things like that. Sorry, sorry. I should have come sooner!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But why did I have to come so quickly? Ah... Helena, you must be doing this on purpose...)

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Please forgive me.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: %s, you can't use it if you keep the elderly waiting. Hehehe. If you say you will forgive me, please apologize profusely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: %s, have a great time. See you later.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You too, made a lot of good memories in Luria.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thank you, old man. This is also fate... , can you take this?
(Yeonhee takes something out of the bag she brought and shows it to Helena.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Elias This is a norigae, a traditional ornament, made by craftsmen and is beautiful. I think it would suit the elderly well.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Oh, this is a precious item. Thank you, lady. It is so elaborate that it can be compared to something made by street artisans in Glaston's workshops.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Can this person invite the lady next time? I'd like to chat about the history of Gendia and Freios... .
(Yeonhee’s eyes sparkle.)

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Oh, of course! I also wanted to hear the elders’ opinions. I'm really looking forward to hearing from the best archaeologist!

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Hehe, thank you for seeing it that way. Then, miss, I will send Leon later, so come and visit me when you have time.

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Thank you, old man.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: %s, shall we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… ? yes… .

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: … goodbye. %s, old man!

lines.speaker: 연희
lines.text: Hmm… . Is something going on? I can't help it. Because there's nothing I can do.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: I'm sorry. You were taken aback when this person suddenly appeared, right?
(Helena starts talking while drinking tea that seems to have been prepared in advance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. But what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: That young lady is traveling to Freios with the support of the Council.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? I didn't know... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You didn't know. Coincidentally, the council's knights and magicians came and called you here.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: If you're with this guy, he won't touch you here Adventurer though.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: It's just a shell of the royal family, but it's useful in times like this. There was already a request from His Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Kai or that kid is always like that. They send me letters in language I can't understand at all.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: A young man named Levi is leaving and you will be back, so I ask you to take care of him for the time being.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's what His Majesty says, then I guess I'll have to do it. If you move carelessly, something dangerous could happen... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Still, Aaron is watching us from over there, so we have to be careful.
(I make eye contact with Aaron for a moment, but ignore it and focus on the conversation with Helena.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I saw him at the Nereis Gate, he said he was doing small work, but in reality, he was the chairman... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: You met Aaron. He's like a snake... . Anyway, this isn't important... .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: Please stay at my place for a moment and observe the situation. Since His Majesty requested it, we will talk about it separately soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: … And, %s… .

lines.speaker: 헬레나
lines.text: When the time comes, will you explain those ruins in the sky? I think it's only visible to my eyes... .
